prompt: How many times has the Turing Award been given to multiple winners in the same year?
answer:
As of 2025, the Turing Award has been given to multiple winners in the same year **18 times**.

The years were:

**1975, 1976, 1983, 1986, 1993, 1994, 2001, 2002, 2004, 2007, 2012, 2015, 2017, 2018, 2020, 2024, and 2025.**

Of these, **three years**—2002, 2007, and 2018—had three co-winners; the other 15 had two.
